ko.title: 벨기에 당국, 구글에 데이터센터 공사 중단 명령…허가 미비

en.title: Belgian authorities order Google to halt data centre construction over missing permits
en.summary: The Guardian reported that Belgian authorities ordered Google to stop building a data centre, saying it lacks the required permits.

zh.title: 比利时当局责令谷歌停建数据中心…许可不全
